source: original V2 repository preservation; prior glTF procedural blockouts
import_policy: Reference-only until integrated, tested and vision-reviewed; do not assume old blockouts are production art

geometry_schema.provenance: Describes the original procedural geometry in src/world.js (PR #307 baseline 006b5e8) against public/reference/approved-yard.png and docs/design/tokens.json; validated by tests/voxelSchema.test.mjs and scripts/capture-art.mjs; ART-06 crane lift cycle (#352) validated by tests/craneMotion.test.mjs and scripts/capture-crane.mjs; ART-05 vehicle rigs (#351) validated by tests/vehicleRigs.test.mjs, scripts/measure-rigs.mjs and scripts/capture-rigs.mjs
geometry_schema.footprint_contract: Logical footprints mirror src/content.js footprintOf() (#370, main e8240a87); crane 2x3, others 1x1. Geometry fields are authored local space; world group scaled by base w/d at the footprint center.

crane_motion.source: src/world.js cranePose/applyCranePose/CRANE_PHASES/CRANE_LIMITS/CRANE_CYCLE_TOTAL (pure, shared by runtime update() and tests)
crane_motion.cargo: empty hook; no load mesh, no teleporting cargo, no implied production; a visible load must mirror a reserved shipment from the simulation authority (#274)
crane_motion.reducedMotion: parked static pose (slew 0, trolley 0.7, drop 0.45) via prefers-reduced-motion matchMedia + change listener
crane_motion.camera_invariants: applyCamera/stampCamera byte-identical to main (sha256-16 f3afa5479a66b97e / 691b3c0a3480e97b, hash-guarded in tests/craneMotion.test.mjs)
crane_motion.schema_declaration_gap: src/voxelSchema.js crane pivot motion still declares oscillate amplitude 0.34 speed 0.24 (validator vocabulary spin|oscillate; file outside the #352 lease); pivot name/offset/axis/swingRadius 4.8 unchanged; vocabulary extension is a follow-up under #262
crane_motion.stage: live motion contract; numeric validation only, not automatically production-approved art parity (G1 #276)

vehicle_rigs.source: src/world.js createTruck/truckIdentity/stepTruck/syncTruckCargo/createForklift/forkliftLift/createDrone/droneHover/activeCycleAnchor/createWorker/rigShell/applyRigLod (pure pose functions shared by runtime update() and tests) + src/voxelSchema.js RIGS/RIG_LOD/rigLodTier/validateRig
vehicle_rigs.provenance: All geometry original, authored in code (shared unit BoxGeometry + 8-segment cylinders, shared MATERIALS pool, flat shading); no external/downloaded models; blockout glTF entries remain reference-only per import_policy

authority.truck: simulation.js freight ledger (reserve/pickup/arrive); crates only while v.cargo onboard, count max(1,min(3,ceil(amount/5))), tinted RESOURCE_BY_ID; empty tray shows nothing
authority.forklift: none — decorative yard crew (#274); fork lift is a pure function of nearest real truck distance to the depot bay post; never carries a load mesh
authority.drone: none — decorative yard crew (#274); hovers over a building only while its real cycle timer advanced frame-over-frame, else parked at DRONE_PAD
authority.worker: none — decorative yard crew (#274); static posed 1.7-unit scale reference, arms posed not animated

vehicle_rigs.identities: truckIdentity(v) = ((v.id % 3) + 3) % 3 preserves original per-id liveries: id%3=1 AMBER STAKE-BED (orange, 4 wheels, beacon), id%3=2 TEAL TIPPER (body, 6 wheels, ram), id%3=0 RUST FLATBED (rust, 4 wheels, headboard slats)
vehicle_rigs.motion: wheelSpin = travelled world distance / 0.3 (real sim deltas * CELL); steer wrap-aware route heading clamp +/-0.45 with decay; suspension bob speed-gated (0 when parked); forkliftLift 0.75 at <=2 units, 0 at >=6; droneHover bob sin(t*1.3)*0.18 rotor t*22

lod.tier2: single-box proxy in rig livery, cargo culled, visibility toggles only

vehicle_rigs.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion parks wheel/steer/bob/beacon/forks/rotors; distance still accrues, truck positions still follow sim, economic timing untouched
vehicle_rigs.camera_invariants: applyCamera/stampCamera byte-identical to main (sha256-16 f3afa5479a66b97e / 691b3c0a3480e97b, hash-guarded in tests/vehicleRigs.test.mjs and scripts/capture-rigs.mjs)
vehicle_rigs.evidence: tests/vehicleRigs.test.mjs (16 tests, full suite 184/184) + scripts/measure-rigs.mjs + scripts/capture-rigs.mjs -> docs/evidence/351-art-05/ (PASS_NUMERIC_ONLY, source_sha 1f571918ab8fdeb76cdafe97079acbdf7b58f212, 20 PNGs + nonblank.json)
vehicle_rigs.stage: live rig contract; numeric validation only, not automatically production-approved art parity (G1 #276); decorative animation is not a completed crew gameplay mechanic (#274)

geometry_schema.stage: live geometry contract; numeric validation only, not automatically production-approved art parity (G1 #276)

assets.purpose: Utility hoist blockout reference; the live procedural crane runs the ART-06 empty-hook lift cycle (geometry_schema.crane_motion); a visible load still requires a reserved shipment (#274)
assets.live_motion: ART-06 #352 deterministic 25.2s 10-phase lift cycle on pivot:crane -> :trolley -> :hoist -> :hook; see geometry_schema.crane_motion and docs/design/VOXEL_GEOMETRY.md
